title: The Lord's Judgment and Salvation for Jerusalem
description: The Lord declares that he will make Jerusalem a cup that causes drunkenness and a heavy stone for all the nations gathering against the city. He strikes the enemy's horses with confusion and blindness, while watching over Judah. The leaders of Judah become like a firepot among wood, consuming the surrounding peoples. The Lord saves the tents of Judah first and protects the inhabitants of Jerusalem so that the weakest becomes like David, and the house of David like God. Finally, he seeks to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
